audit.why: TRICKY early / TF mid framing fits the 54.19% WR over 4506 games: she zones level 1, TF out-shoves from 2 and owns 6 and first item, late flattens on her range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart gave Lux rows 1-3 and Skill rows 4-5, against content/packet which give TF at Level 2, Skill 3-5, TF at 6 and first item.
audit.why: Grounded: Stacked Deck out-shoves at 2, her 10s Q cooldown makes 3-5 a skill window, Destiny plus gold card punishes an immobile escape-less mage at 6 and first item. win[] already agreed, so side-only flips with rewritten whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; Prismatic Barrier's burst absorption and the Illumination auto-reset tell (both flagged missing interactions) were absent; twenty-one fields called Lux he/his; spikes[0].text claimed a '12-plus second root' when Q is a flat 10s.
audit.why: Kit: Q 10s flat 1175 range, W 12s shield, E 10s zone, R 60/50/40s at 3340 range; P is an auto-reset combo tell. Lux is she/her.
audit.corrected: Numbers and both missing interactions added; all pronouns fixed; root cooldown corrected to 10s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No digit in the cooldowns field.
audit.why: Q 10s and W 12s are the punishable timers; R 60s makes blind shoves lethal.
